title: Parking Citation Fee Updates Take Effect November 30
description: The City of New Rochelle announces that updated parking citation fees will take effect on Monday, November 30, 2026.

title: Retired NRFD Chief Andy Sandor Named Grand Marshal of the New Rochelle Thanksgiving Parade
description: Honoring Three Decades of Service to New Rochelle as the City Celebrates “We the People... Celebrating America’s 250th”

title: New Rochelle City Manager Releases 2027 Proposed Budget
description: Budget maintains key community investments while strengthening financial oversight and addressing rising municipal costs amid broader economic pressures

title: New Rochelle BID Named Presenting Sponsor of the 62nd Annual New Rochelle Thanksgiving Parade
description: This year’s theme, “We the People... Celebrating America’s 250th,” commemorates the nation’s historic milestone while celebrating the people, diversity, traditions and community spirit that make New Rochelle such a special place to live, work and visit.

title: Press Release: Child Assault and Animal Cruelty
New Rochelle Youth Bureau Announces Annual Give A Gift Program
description: The New Rochelle Youth Bureau is excited to announce the return of its annual Give A Gift program, a cherished tradition that has been bringing holiday cheer to local children for years.

title: New Rochelle Youth Bureau’s Annual Turkey Giveaway Now Open for Registration
description: Residents can receive one free turkey per household, while supplies last. Residents must RSVP in advance by calling the New Rochelle Youth Bureau at 914-654-2045.

title: New Rochelle Fire Department Awards & Promotion Ceremony
description: The New Rochelle Fire Department hosted their Awards and Promotion Ceremony on Thursday, October 22 in the Council Chambers in City Hall.

title: New Rochelle Mayor Yadira Ramos-Herbert Delivers 2026 State of the City Address
description: In her third State of the City address, Mayor Ramos-Herbert highlights investments in community, small businesses, and quality of life improvements as New Rochelle continues on its path towards economic growth

title: City of New Rochelle to Host Halloween- Themed Plaza Night at Anderson on October 29
description: Evening of music, a Thriller dance performance, a Halloween costume contest and downtown business specials will bring seasonal fun to Anderson Plaza.
